groups.description: ONE electrical group a, comprising the two circuit drawings side by side, not separate a and b circuits.

Left circuit. Capacitor on central vertical branch; two horizontal parallel plates, upper positive and lower negative. Source labels q_m beside upper plate and -q_m beside lower plate. Four plus signs and four minus marks are visible between plates. Capacitor lower lead connects to common bottom wire. Switch pivot above upper plate; blade slopes up-left to contact 1, closing the battery charging path. Contact 2 to its right stays disconnected. Left branch is a two-cell series battery: each upper long plate positive, lower short plate negative. Top wire joins battery to contact 1. Bottom wire joins battery, capacitor lower lead and right coil. Contact 2 joins top right wire and a vertical four-lobe coil; coil continues to bottom wire. No current arrow or numeric component value in this source drawing.

Middle circuit repeats the same two-cell battery, four-lobe coil, capacitor polarity and q_m/-q_m labels. Blade slopes up-right from capacitor pivot to contact 2, closing the LC loop. Contact 1 on the battery wire stays disconnected. Thus the battery is isolated while the capacitor and coil form the oscillating circuit. Four plus and four minus marks remain visible on the capacitor at the depicted switching instant. No invented current magnitude or phase annotation.

Mechanical group b at right. Fixed horizontal hatched support; vertical zigzag spring attached below it; solid round mass below the spring, marked by a short rightward horizontal position connector. A shared horizontal broken reference line at the spring's lower unextended/reference position is labelled equilibrium position in Chinese. The mass is below this reference. A vertical displacement marker to the right spans reference to mass, with source x_m label (vector accent visible). A vertical mark continues below the mass. The mechanical b label is under this apparatus. No velocity arrow, force arrow or numerical displacement value is given.

modernAdditions: English labels and Latin a/b instead of source Cyrillic-like group lettering.
